newsitem.title: costa rica: Costa Rica serial killer's toll could top 31.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica serial killer's toll could top 31.

text.p: Costa Rican police said on Monday the number of victims of a mysterious serial killer known as "The Psychopath" could exceed 31.

A week ago officials had attributed 17 dead or missing people to the killer. He preys on young women and their lovers while they are kissing in secluded places. The latest female victim, as in other cases attributed to "The Psychopath", had her breasts and reproductive organs mutilated.

Costa Rica's Judicial Police on Monday distributed photographs of 12 people missing so far this year who could be victims of the serial killer. Police said they hope the photos will aid the investigation.

Authorities fear "The Psychopath" may have returned after several years of inactivity since a pair of young lovers was found in the hills south of San Jose a week ago, each shot in the head with a .45 calibre bullet that could have fired from a pistol or an M-3 sub-machinegun.
